page_title: FUL 0-1 ARS | Fulham v Arsenal 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' Arsenal work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+9' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
90+7' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+6' Substitution. Viktor Gyökeres did his best and is replaced by Christian Norgaard (Arsenal).
90+5' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
90+4' Arsenal are seeing far more of the ball now.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
90' The ball is out of play. Fulham win a corner kick.
90' Adama Traore (Fulham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fulham.
88' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
85' Viktor Gyökeres receives a sweet pass inside the box from Jurrien Timber (Arsenal), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.
85' The possession of the ball – 34:66.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Harry Wilson walks off the pitch to be replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).
82' Here is a change. Jorge Cuenca is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Calvin Bassey (Fulham).
81' A substitution has been made. Leandro Trossard is replaced by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal).
77' Sander Berge (Fulham) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
75' Kevin (Fulham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
74' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 7:2.
72' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but David Raya punches the ball away.
72' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes.
70' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
70' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Timothy Castagne (Fulham).
69' NO PENALTY! Referee Anthony Taylor has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Arsenal players are incensed.
66' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
65' Referee Anthony Taylor sees the trip by Kevin (Fulham) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a penalty to Arsenal! Let's see who's going to take it.
64' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) comes onto the pitch after Tom Cairney signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
63' Substitution. Joshua King leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kevin (Fulham).
62' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a change. Mikel Merino (Arsenal) replaces Eberechi Eze.
58' 0 - 1 Goal! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
58' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.

55' Alex Iwobi is the provider with a good cross and Harry Wilson (Fulham) shows great determination to get to the ball on the edge of the box, but he blazes it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
54' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
54' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
52' Harry Wilson (Fulham) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
51' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
50' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes it short.
50' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

49' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
48' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Bukayo Saka. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+7' Declan Rice (Arsenal) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
45+5' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:7.
45+4' The ball goes behind for a corner. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+3' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45+3' Arsenal are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Arsenal.
44' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
44' Arsenal keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
42' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) is substituted due to injury. Marco Silva gives a chance to Issa Diop.
39' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
39' The ball is cleared after Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

38' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.

37' Bernd Leno pulls off a great save to deny Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
36' Arsenal enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
36' Arsenal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

35' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
33' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
33' Tom Cairney (Fulham) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
31' The game is interrupted now, Tom Cairney (Fulham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' Fulham earn a corner.
30' Joshua King (Fulham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Raya intercepts the ball.
29' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
28' The Arsenal players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
26' Ooh that was close! Harry Wilson (Fulham) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
26' Great teamplay by Fulham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
24' 37:63 – the latest ball possession ratio.
22' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
20' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
19' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
19' Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
18' Harry Wilson (Fulham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
18' Joshua King (Fulham) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
17' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle as Raul Jimenez (Fulham) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
16' A goal, which was scored by Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal), was disallowed due to offside.
15' Neat passing move from Arsenal in order to create new attacking opportunities.

13' What a chance that is! Harry Wilson (Fulham) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
12' Tom Cairney (Fulham) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
12' Fulham get a corner.
11' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Raul Jimenez (Fulham) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
9' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
8' A lofted cross from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

6' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
5' Arsenal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
3' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
3' Rough tackle by Timothy Castagne (Fulham). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Fulham will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Anthony Taylor.
